RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

That number reflects substantial uncertainty, not a statistically grounded estimate. An all-male panel is worth noting as a concern about the selection process, but it does not establish that sex influenced this decision.

Your longer experience and project leadership justify seeking a substantive explanation. However, client relationships, business development and people management may legitimately outweigh years of design experience for a group-head role.

Follow up now, requesting the selection criteria, their weighting and feedback against them. You can neutrally ask how the panel ensured a fair, bias-aware assessment. Preserve the advertisement and correspondence. If explanations reveal inconsistent standards or sex-related assumptions, consider local employment advice; complaint deadlines can be short.
